author: Ruturaj R Raval

target.object: The minimum positive cyclic binary covering-sequence length L(12,3)

problem.length_convention: positive cyclic length with all window indices reduced modulo the sequence length

current_supported_claim.statement: The exact binary cyclic covering-sequence length for window length 12 and Hamming radius 3 is L(12,3) = 36.
current_supported_claim.lower_bound: Two independent exhaustive traversals exclude every positive length from 1 through 35.
current_supported_claim.upper_bound: The attributed 36-bit CPro1 witness has covering radius exactly 3.

upper_bound_evidence.provenance: Attributed to the public CPro1 construction

limitations: The exhaustive implementations are independently tested but not formally verified.
The length-36 witness is prior art and is not claimed as project-original.
No classification of all optimal length-36 sequences is claimed.
No external mathematical or peer review is claimed.
The public prior-art audit cannot exclude unpublished or unindexed work.
